prompts.text: My little brother is so silly, he tried to feed our goldfish a ___.
The class hamster escaped and we finally found him inside a ___.
Our teacher's desk is so messy there is a whole ___ in the top drawer.
My sister is so fussy, she will only eat food shaped like a ___.
Dad's pancakes were so bad that even the dog ___.
The school bus was so full I had to sit on a ___.
The playground puddle was so big we needed a ___ to get across it.
Grandma's handbag is so deep she once pulled a whole ___ out of it.
Our snowman melted so fast that all that was left was a hat and a ___.
My baby cousin is certain the vacuum cleaner is really a ___.
The birthday cake was so enormous it took us ___ to finish it.
Our cat is so lazy that he sleeps right on top of the ___.
The science experiment went wrong and the whole classroom smelled like ___.
My brother's room is so untidy there could be a ___ living in there.
The bouncy castle was so bouncy that I bounced straight into the ___.
At sports day I ran so fast that I lost my ___.
My tooth was so wobbly it fell out while I was ___.
The library book was so overdue that the fine was bigger than my ___.
School lunch was such a mystery today that we think it might have been ___.
The parrot in the pet shop would not stop shouting ___.
My homework was eaten by something far worse than a dog — a ___.
The swimming pool was so cold that my ___ turned blue.
Our tent blew away in the wind and landed in a ___.
The ice cream van is so loud you can hear it all the way from ___.
Mum's car is so full of snacks there is a ___ under every seat.
It rained so hard at the match that our football turned into a ___.
My uncle's beard is so bushy he could hide a whole ___ in there.
The pillow fight got out of hand and somebody knocked over the ___.
The class spider escaped and turned up inside the teacher's ___.
My little sister named her teddy bear ___.
Our kite got stuck so high in the tree we had to use a ___ to reach it.
The school talent show ended early when somebody's ___ got loose.
